summary: EY is multinational professional services network based in England, founded in 1989. Type: private company. About 300,000 employees (Wikidata). Revenue $40.0 billion (2021). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 5 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

insights.one_liner: One of the Big Four audit and advisory firms; 21 roles here, mostly Amsterdam and Rotterdam, 95% in English but mostly manager or senior level.

culture.text: Openings are in Amsterdam (15), Rotterdam (4), The Hague and Eindhoven, split between consulting and finance.
Staff mostly have accounting and finance backgrounds.
Describes a flexible, caring environment with personalised learning and a broad well-being benefits package.
Huge network: about 409,265 people on LinkedIn, in more than 150 countries.

open.text: EY Nederland B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
95% of its 21 jobs here don't require Dutch, though none mention visa support.
Few starter roles: 3 internships and 1 entry-level job versus 17 manager or senior roles.

growth.text: Grew from 231,000 staff in 2016 to 312,250 in 2021, then 300,000 in 2022.

worth_knowing.text: Started a three-year partnership with Amsterdam Dance Event, building a personal AI assistant for festival visitors.
